Brilliant staff and nice food.
Jul 2017
We had a little trouble finding this small place as they have changed name to VIBE BURGER. Managed to notice the place with the photos sent in by previous explorers (yes, the small alley with fairy lightings on the ceiling). It is located on the 2nd floor (known as 1st floor in HCMC), overseeing Ben Thanh market.

Food portion is relatively big for us (small eaters), and we ended up ordering a lot! The 3 staff were the best, speaking good simple English and extremely spontaneous to our request to film us doing a mannequin challenge.

Overall quiet and cosy.

Thank you for the nice food and great videography skills!

Get your caffeine fix here!
May 2016 • Solo
Café Anh is one of those elusive coffee shops that you really want to stumble upon on an outrageously hot ☀️day in HCMC knowing you can cool down and get your ☕️caffeine fix whilst being able to observe the chaos outside rather than be part of it! I think I’d started getting coffee withdrawal headaches (or was that condensed milk withdrawal😳?!) in the morning after getting accustomed to strong viet coffee during my stay so this place was an impromptu blessing. Grab a coffee to go or take a seat in the quaint little café adorned with ornamental birdcages and fluffy cushions after a serious haggling session💵 at Ben Thanh market as I did! Venture out onto the balcony for the view @mitalhungrymig

Trendy ambiance and delicious Vietnamese food.
Oct 2016 • Couples
We stayed in a Boutique Hotel situated in District 2 of HCMC for 4 nights and one evening we wanted to have diner outside our hotel.
During daytime we passed with our taxi by Cafe An, a trendy restaurant with a surprising patchwork of old and new furniture surrounded by tropical plants.
We made a reservation and were looking forward to have diner the same evening in that special environement.
We were welcomed by a sympathique French guy who explained to us the concept, the menu and the special selections of cocktails.

We ordered amazing cocktails, different Vietnamese dishes for diner and some wine.
After a while our table was filled with colorful local dishes. The food was delicious and the presentation very original. Price / Quality was perfect.

The staff was very enthusiastic, proffesional, speaks well English and we had a lovely chat with one of the managers.

Unfortunately on that moment the shop at the backside of the restaurant was closed and we did not had time to return the next day … but worth to visit.

If you like to have a delicious Vietnamese diner in a trendy ambiance, go to Cafe An !

Pure Enjoyment perched above the hustle of Ben Thanh Market!
Aug 2016 • Friends
Before taking on the Ben Thanh market my friend and I decided we needed an iced coffee as fortification. We just happened to stumble upon this charming cafe's sign and followed the arrows up a narrow flight of steps at the top of which was what looked like a family's apartment on one side and a door to the cafe on the other. Entering the cafe the decor immediately invites you to sit and stay a while. Lovely tree murals are given dimension by real life bird houses nestled in to the branches. We opted for the outdoor patio which offered a birds eye view of the hustle and bustle of the very high energy area. The mocha rich iced coffees were divine and just what we needed to prepare for shopping excursion in to the market. Can't wait to return and try the yummy looking food that I spied other customers enjoying.
